2609.01810.title: TalkFa: A Unified Benchmark for Farsi Dialogue Generation and Understanding
2609.01810.paper_summary: Farsi, spoken by more than 120 million people, lacks a comprehensive benchmark for dialogue generation and understanding. We introduce TALKFA, a unified benchmark comprising three complementary datasets: (1) WIKI-FADIAL, 4.2K Wikipedia-grounded dialogues for knowledge-grounded generation; (2) DAILYDIALOG-FA, 6.6K dialogues annotated for dialogue acts and emotions; and (3) PLAYDIAL-FA, 2.1K theatrical dialogues with sentiment labels. While LLMs assist data construction, every dialogue undergoes multi-stage review and revision by native Farsi speakers, and only the final human-approved dialogues are released. Experiments with six LLAMA and MISTRAL models show that LoRA substantially improves dialogue generation while requiring only 25-50% of the training data to recover over 90% of the final performance gains. Across classification tasks, FABERT achieves the best dialogue-act performance, LORA-MISTRAL-7B performs best on emotion recognition, and MISTRAL-24B achieves the highest sentiment score. Human evaluation and independent external validation demonstrate the reliability of the benchmark, while comparisons with GPT-4.1 as an LLM judge reveal that automatic metrics substantially overestimate dialogue quality. Zero-shot evaluation with frontier LLMs further shows that TalkFa remains a challenging benchmark. We will release all datasets, annotation guidelines, code, and checkpoints.
2609.01810.paper_summary_zh: 波斯語有超過1.2億的使用者，但缺乏一個全面的對話生成和理解基準。我們介紹了TALKFA，一個統一的基準，包含三個互補的數據集：(1) WIKI-FADIAL，4.2K基於維基百科的對話，用於知識驅動的生成；(2) DAILYDIALOG-FA，6.6K標註了對話行為和情感的對話；以及(3) PLAYDIAL-FA，2.1K帶有情感標籤的戲劇對話。雖然大型語言模型協助數據構建，但每個對話都經過母語波斯語使用者的多階段審查和修訂，只有最終經過人類批准的對話才會被發布。對六個LLAMA和MISTRAL模型的實驗顯示，LoRA顯著改善了對話生成，同時僅需25-50%的訓練數據即可恢復超過90%的最終性能增益。在分類任務中，FABERT在對話行為表現上達到最佳，LORA-MISTRAL-7B在情感識別上表現最佳，而MISTRAL-24B則達到最高的情感得分。人類評估和獨立的外部驗證證明了該基準的可靠性，而與GPT-4.1作為大型語言模型的比較顯示，自動指標大幅高估了對話質量。與前沿大型語言模型的零樣本評估進一步顯示，TalkFa仍然是一個具有挑戰性的基準。我們將發布所有數據集、標註指南、代碼和檢查點。
